title: HardcodingFinding
description: A single finding emitted by scan-hardcoding. schema_version is the stable public API contract; consumers MUST reject records with a higher major version than they support.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Consumers must check this field and reject unknown versions. Breaking changes bump this integer.

rule.description: Rule identifier in kebab-case or category.rule-name form.

file.description: Absolute or repo-relative path to the file containing the finding.

col.description: 1-based column number of the match start.

severity.description: Severity level of the finding. 'critical' and 'high' should block CI when --fail-on is set.

confidence.description: Confidence that the finding is a true positive. 'low' findings may be noisy.

proposal.description: The proposal ID (e.g. 'P448') that tracks remediation of this finding category.

match.description: The matched text or pattern that triggered the rule.

snippet.description: The source line (truncated to 120-200 chars) containing the match.

fix.description: Human-readable remediation suggestion. May include TypeScript code blocks. AI agents should use this field to determine the correct fix.

tags.description: Rule tags for filtering. Common tags: paths, credentials, models, workflow, multi-tenant.

acknowledged_debt.description: True if the finding is acknowledged as technical debt via a TODO(PNN) comment nearby. Severity is reduced by one level for acknowledged findings.

context_before.description: Up to 2 lines before the match line (truncated to 100 chars each).

context_after.description: Up to 2 lines after the match line (truncated to 100 chars each).
